description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractOperation that implements the Operation interface and registers itself with a singleton Operations instance upon instantiation. It serves as a base class for specific operation implementations within the calculator application.

classes.name: AbstractOperation
classes.description: An abstract class that provides common bookkeeping functionality for calculator operations, registering itself with the Operations singleton upon creation.

methods.description: Constructor that registers this operation instance with the singleton Operations registry.
